script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmic clock just struck midnight on your wild, unbridled ambition today. Right now, the Sun forms a tense opposition from your 7th House of Partnerships, forcing you to look honestly at how others mirror your fiery, stubborn Fire sign deeply. Saturn sits firmly in your 11th House of Networks, rewarding only your most strategic, long-term alliances with others. Love: Venus trines your ruling planet Mars tonight, igniting instant, electric chemistry, but take a deep breath before promising anything permanent to your soulmate or partner. Career: Mercury sextiles the Midheaven in your 10th House, making this the perfect day to pitch that promotion directly to your boss. Speak up loudly now. Your voice carries extra power. Warning: Never sign legal documents after dusk or a hidden clause will haunt you for months ahead. Follow for tomorrow's reading and never miss the stars.
